meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，你可以直接向它提问这个代码库的问题。它会读项目根目录的知识图谱 JSON，按关键词搜索其中的节点、边和分层，只用相关的那一小块子图来回答，并指向具体文件和函数。
howto.when: 当你想问代码库相关的问题、想借助知识图谱理解代码时触发。若项目根目录里没有知识图谱文件，它会先让你运行 /understand。

say.text: 这个项目的入口文件是哪个？
say.note: 它会从图谱中找对应节点并给出位置和说明

say.text: 哪些模块依赖 config 这一层？
say.note: 它会沿依赖边找出上下游节点

say.text: 帮我查 chat 相关的节点
say.note: 它会在 name、summary、tags 里搜索匹配项

howto.what_en: Once installed, you can ask questions about your codebase. It reads the knowledge graph JSON in the project root, greps matching nodes, edges and layers, and answers using only that relevant subgraph, pointing to specific files and functions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to ask questions about a codebase or understand code with the knowledge graph. If no knowledge-graph.json exists in the project root, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: What is the entry file of this project?
say_en.note: It finds the matching node and gives its location

say_en.text: Which modules depend on the config layer?
say_en.note: It follows dependency edges to upstream and downstream nodes
It greps name, summary and tags for matches
